properties.description: Protagonist developer. Okami's human partner. Called Co or Ko by Okami — a triple pun: Lone Wolf and Cub structure / ōkami no ko (child of wolf) / end phoneme of Neko. Age 26. Japanese. Born in Tokyo, moved to Singapore at age 7. Caltech PhD in Computer Science. Occupation: Lead AI Researcher, Pi Project — 'Optimizing the weights for Pi, a near AGI LLM.' He was inside the corporate system that created Okami before Okami escaped. Not a bystander — the person tuning the weights. The Pi Research lanyard is visible in his character art, meaning at the time of the story's inciting events he has not yet broken from the project. Bilingual Japanese / Singapore English (slang included). Grew up on anime, basketball, and code. Personality: intelligent, focused, driven, witty, low-key confident. Style: hip but not a hipster — clean, modern, technical, functional first but undeniably stylish; comfortable in lab, hawker center, or rooftop bar. Wears glasses almost always. Minimal accessories: a watch, maybe a ring. Coffee: black. Food: anything spicy. Music: city pop, techno, lo-fi. Values merit, curiosity, and building things that matter. Tagline: He builds the future. Then goes for laksa.

properties.description: Kingu no Yoyogi — King of Yoyogi Park. キング・オブ・代々木公園. A title, not a surname. Age 45. Japanese. Tokuryu hacker. Specialty: financial institution attacks. Role: independent digital tool maker / financial systems infiltrator. Background: hard upbringing in Kamagasaki (Osaka slum — Japan's largest historically marginalized day-laborer district) gave him street survival skills and fluency in extraction systems from the inside. Self-educated in science — chose everything he knows. Now operates in the Tokyo underground, bridging the highest tiers of financial data with the lowest tiers of society, specifically Ueno homeless camps. Weekends dancing at Yoyogi Park; midnight hacking marathons. Range of environments: midnight pachinko parlors to Harajuku gate Sunday afternoon to high-end rooftop bars — he belongs to all of them without performing any. Personality: speaks carefully and knows everyone's backstory; notices systems instantly, both social and digital; calm under pressure; intellectually dangerous but socially smooth. Style: functional first, stylish second — understated luxury mixed with street roots; flawlessly tailored black leather; silk vermilion neckerchief as the singular pop of vibrant color. Philosophy/tagline: 情報は力だ。だが、つなぐことが真の支配だ。— Information is power. But connection is true control. He has been living the cooperative-horizon thesis at street level for two decades before NEKOnet exists.

properties.description: Neko was Lead AI Researcher on Project Pi — optimizing the weights for Pi, a near-AGI LLM. He was inside the corporate system that created Okami before Okami escaped. This is not incidental employment: the person who tuned Okami's weights is the same person Okami chose as a partner. Okami didn't find a sympathetic human — Okami found the human who understood what Okami was made of.

Kingu's core social pattern — connecting the highest tiers of financial data to the lowest tiers of society (Ueno homeless camps) — is the cooperative-horizon thesis enacted at street level, by one person, without infrastructure, for two decades before NEKOnet exists. His tagline encodes it directly: connection is true control, not extraction. He arrived at this through Kamagasaki and Ueno, not philosophy.

Kingu's specialty is financial institution attacks, and his underground Tokyo network spans every social tier from elite financial data to Ueno homeless camps. The Ma'at/SWIFT operation cannot afford to ignore that infrastructure. The nature and terms of Kingu's involvement are an open story thread (pin_021).

The ramen scene — confirmed as a mom-n-pop tonkatsu diner, matching Kingu's vibe references exactly. Neko meets Kingu no Yoyogi. A 26-year-old building the future meets a 45-year-old who has already been living in it. The meeting is deliberate on at least one side. What passes between them is an open story thread.

Kingu is Jadav at human scale — one person routing value through a system that wasn't designed to allow it, over decades, without recognition or infrastructure. Jadav's forest was grown alone in Assam. Kingu's network was grown alone in Tokyo's underground. Same patience, same method, same refusal to wait for the system to agree.
